Scenario fixture: rgaa-img-no-alt-decorative (RGAA 1.2.1)

Each target has a stable id of the form inad_case_NN. An <img> with no alt fails 1.1.1 if it carries information and 1.2.1 if it is decorative: a spacer fails here, the others are asked about, and the only content of a link is left to 1.1.1.

A. Spacers (FAIL)

01 — FAIL: 1 by 1 px image with no alt
02 — FAIL: horizontal rule image, 2 px high, with no alt

B. Decorative or informative, for a person (CANTTELL)

03 — CANTTELL: photo with no alt
04 — CANTTELL: icon with no alt next to a link's text
Annual report

C. Out of scope

05 — NOT APPLICABLE: image that is a link's only content (informative, 1.1.1)
06 — NOT APPLICABLE: image with alt=""
07 — NOT APPLICABLE: image with a caption
08 — NOT APPLICABLE: image with a title
